profile.headline: Software Engineer at GEICO
profile.summary: I am working as a Technical Analyst for GEICO. I am a graduate of the Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with degrees in Management Information Systems and New Media Marketing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Write Back-End (C#.NET), API and Front-End (TypeScript, React) code with SpecFlow and Unit test cases.
- Graduated Revature C# Bootcamp

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
- Translated business requirements to technical user stories with design 
mock-ups, and acceptance criteria.
- Led Bug monitoring effort that reduced quote stops from technical errors 
from 14.2% to under 1%
- Agile Project management as a Scrum Master and Product Owner leading 
daily stand-up meetings and retrospectives, grooming and organizing the 
backlog, and delivering projects on time.
- Completed Technology Development Rotational Program to learn from teams throughout the Tech organization

positions.title: Data/Product Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed data from Bellefield’s OCG Live product and prepared recommendations.
- Developed a tool that converted client rules from Excel to JSON data packages that reduced the team’s time spent creating rules by 50%

positions.title: Entrepreneur
positions.description:
I worked on an interdisciplinary team to develop a startup and product, the Down-B backpack for videogamers.

Key activities I was involved in:
Customer discovery interviews
Market research
Investor-style presentation

positions.title: NTID Student Notetaker
positions.description:
Prepared notes for deaf and hard-of-hearing students. Developed ability to distill important lecture information and organize into easily understandable notes.

Classes I've prepared notes for:
•	Fall 2016: Financial Accounting, Statistics 1	
•	Spring 2017: Management Accounting, Statistics 2 
•	Fall 2017: Calculus, Systems Analysis and Design

positions.title: Summer Marketing Intern
positions.description: Assisted with marketing and digital sales, including completing a StoryBrand online training course and helped apply the principles to Flint Tech’s branding.

honors.title: RIT Honors Program
honors.issuer: Issued by Rochester Institute of Technology
